review_phase: Independent source-based review before worker runs and oracle freeze
method: Read the shared tasks, configurations, researcher oracles, benchmark integrations, and fixed upstream RTL declarations, generate conditions, assignment guards, packed dimensions, package formulas, and register/assertion macros. No compiler output or worker answer was used as oracle truth in this review.

semantic_verification.cva6_counter: Confirmed DEPTH 8, ADDR_DEPTH 3, 4-bit status counters, nine syntactically present q reads, three q writes, five n writes and one n read, default-disabled procedural fall-through accesses, boundary request acceptance, reset/flush priority, and 3-bit usage truncation at full occupancy.
semantic_verification.floo_config: Confirmed 23-bit flit; data/valid widths (69,12), (138,6), and (46,8); virtual/physical/bypass branches; stream-FIFO counts 12/6/0 and arbiter counts 3/0/0; requested generated paths and parent-scope connection expressions; virtual child pointer/count widths 3 and packed memory width 115; declaration defaults and omitted clr_i connections.
semantic_verification.axi_types: Confirmed channel widths AW 83, W 150, B 13, AR 77, and R 142; aggregate request/response widths 315/160; five typed fifo_v3 children under i_buffer and none under i_wire; buffered Depth 5 and FALL_THROUGH 1 with DATA_WIDTH still 32; reverse B/R connection direction.
semantic_verification.idma_state: Confirmed lane width 13, dataflow input width 39, each lane data_q width 65, each lane pointer width 4, three-lane stored-q total 219, packet memory width 195, packet count/usage width 3, and separate flush-versus-clear macro behavior. A simultaneous enabled write may still update packet memory when flush is asserted.

fixes_applied.change: Replaced compressed and run-together expected-answer strings with readable complete sentences, explicit signal names, equations, parameter values, source expressions, and hierarchical paths.
fixes_applied.semantic_effect: No expected numeric result, instance path, selected branch, criterion count, or scoring weight changed. Reset/flush inactivity was stated explicitly for ordinary occupancy transitions, as already implied by the separate priority criterion.

fixes_applied.change: Corrected source-reference ranges: the CVA6 usage declaration is line 33; Floo branch, loop, connection, package-formula, and clr_i references now point to their actual locations.

findings.finding: The original supplied slice had eight upstream .sv files plus the integration top. floo_pkg also references axi_pkg in functions at lines 466-487, so complete semantic checking requires the pinned axi_pkg source even though the benchmark questions do not ask about those functions.
findings.resolution: Parent reported that it is adding the pinned axi_pkg.sv and its license from the same Floo checkout, exposing identical sources to both arms. The corrected inventory is nine upstream .sv files plus top.sv: ten sources total, with eight dependencies besides floo_fifo. This correction does not change the expected benchmark facts.
findings.required_check: Verify the added file, provenance hash, license, runtime copy, and clean package resolution before freeze.

findings.finding: floo_vc_arbiter syntactically references cc_credit_counter at lines 127-141 only inside VcImpl == VcCredit. The integration retains VcImpl = VcNaive, so this unavailable definition is not required for the selected elaboration.
findings.resolution: Do not require a worker to supply an inactive credit-counter definition or count it as an active instance.

findings.finding: COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF suppresses assertions explicitly guarded by that macro in cc_fifo, cc_rr_arb_tree, cc_lzc, and relevant cc_pkg checks. It does not globally disable assertions.svh macros: that header uses ASSERTS_OFF, SYNTHESIS, and XILINX_SIMULATOR to control INC_ASSERT. floo_vc_arbiter's ASSERT and ASSERT_INIT sites are not guarded by COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF.
findings.resolution: Keep the same public define in both arms. Do not describe all Floo assertions as disabled, and do not silently add a different define to only one arm. The selected VcNaive setting satisfies the source SupportedNumVirtChannels expression.

findings.finding: The b_bits connection_source range 148-167 omits .data_i(mst_resp_i.b) at line 146. The output connection is at line 148.
findings.resolution: Suggested source range 134-150. The expected B width, direction, instance name, and actual expressions are correct.

findings.finding: AXI and iDMA tasks request supporting arithmetic, source references, connections, and parameter propagation beyond their eight scored items. Their oracles explicitly treat this as explanation quality rather than extra hidden scored items. CVA6 and Floo use broader criteria with an explicit 0/0.5/1 scale.
findings.resolution: Apply each published rubric consistently to both arms, report explanation completeness separately where requested, and do not invent extra points or change the rubric after reading worker answers. Exact diagnostic identifiers, MCP calls, and exact prose formatting are not grading requirements.

findings.finding: The shared task asks for a knowledge boundary around omitted clr_i. A source-only answer can correctly explain the language-level unconnected-input behavior as well as the absence of an explicit intended clear driver.
findings.resolution: Accept a technically correct explanation of unconnected-input simulation behavior; do not demand compiler-specific recovery or require a vague uncertainty statement when source semantics justify a more precise claim. Do reject an unsupported claim that clr_i was intentionally tied low or that the FIFO module definition is missing.

fairness_assessment: All four shared tasks are answerable from the fixed available RTL and public compilation configuration, request source-level static conclusions, and do not mandate MCP calls or a compiler-only diagnostic code. Hidden dependency directories are disclosed in AXI/iDMA README files. Generated integrations are identified as benchmark-owned; source defaults are distinguished from instance overrides. The package-closure correction must be applied equally before the run. No semantic oracle error was identified in the requested scored facts.
remaining_pre_freeze_actions: Parent must finish and verify the Floo axi_pkg dependency/provenance/runtime closure correction.
AXI owner should correct the B-channel connection source-reference range.
Regenerate researcher oracle hashes after these pre-run wording/reference fixes and freeze them before launching workers.
